articles.title: 'Touch the sky with glory': Indian Air Force turns 94
articles.summary: A 68-year-old customer, despite using only cheques and no ATM, lost Rs 1.59 lakh via unauthorized AePS withdrawal. A consumer court ordered SBI to refund the amount with 9% interest. This incident highlights vulnerabilities in digital payment systems, emphasizing stronger security and consumer protection against financial frauds.

articles.title: Nana Patekar dies at 75: Veteran actor served with Indian Army in Kargil War in 1999
articles.summary: Renowned actor Nana Patekar passed away at 5:20 am on Thursday after suffering a cardiac arrest at his residence. Dr. Shekhar Salkar, chief of oncology at Manipal Hospital, confirmed the news to ANI. This unfortunate event marks the loss of a prominent figure in the entertainment industry, widely recognized for his versatile performances and impactful roles.
